reviews.text: Do not have Gmail  cannot use email cleaner and that is the reason I bought this app.  It does not tell you that before you purchase

reviews.text: I can see all the calendar items that need deleted but capped how to delete them.

reviews.title: Won’t work and paid $. DON’T WASTE $$
reviews.text: I got this per google suggestion as I had the same contact for my daughter 5 times and I didn’t have what google was telling me to do. This app won’t stay open long enough to do any good. If this keeps up, probably going to cancel subscription because what good is it doing me?  If it starts working and not force closing, I’ll edit my review, but not worth it.
